rationale: Distinct drawn caustic states need frames; the 41-cell repeat and 48-frame loop are independent decisions.

design_guidelines.artistic_direction: A calm illustrated water surface whose caustics morph in place.
design_guidelines.concept_twist: A familiar pool-caustic texture becomes a continuous, role-readable moving snake surface.
design_guidelines.body_strategy: Caustics stay broad enough to read at 4 cells, develop by 6-7 cells, and tile through long turns while the head glow retains head-over-tail priority.
design_guidelines.asset_strategy: Request a production-quality 20 fps sheet with 48 derived rows; both x and final-to-zero y joins must be seamless, with a complete calm row zero.

fidelity_features: morphing caustic shapes without whole-image translation
layer_plan: Outline and Body fallback ribbons preserve role readability
Water sheet tiles across the body above Body fallback

asset_plan.prompt: 656x768 grid: 41 body cells by 48 frame rows, no gutters; each row is one complete view, x and final-to-zero y seamless, row zero calm, features morph in place instead of translating.

animation_plan: Play all 48 rows once over 2400ms; row zero is reduced motion
risks: Generated rows may translate the whole field or make the loop seam visible
